description: Advanced JavaScript runtime semantics, prototypes, lexical environments, deep cloning, and functional composition archetypes.

archetypes.name: Lexical Scope Boundary & Variable Shadowing Guard
archetypes.coreConcept: Enforcing block scoping and preventing variable leakage across execution contexts, ensuring outer variables remain accessible without accidental variable shadowing.
mentalModel: 1. Isolate variable bindings inside explicit block and function scopes.
2. Prevent reassignment of outer lexical identifiers.
3. Guarantee clean execution environment without polluting global scope.
archetypes.governingInvariant: innerBindings shadow within block without mutating outer scope bindings

cognitiveTraps.name: Var Declaration Scope Leak
cognitiveTraps.description: Using var instead of let/const causes variable hoisting to function scope, leaking loop variables.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Loop with var i; check outer scope or timeout callback; all closures see terminal i.

realWorldDomains.description: Isolating plugin options from modifying host runtime configuration.

archetypes.name: Prototype Inheritance & Explicit This Binding Invoker
archetypes.coreConcept: Managing dynamic this context binding across detached callbacks and delegating method resolution through the prototype chain.
mentalModel: 1. Explicitly bind context receiver to handlers using Function.prototype.bind or arrow wrappers.
2. Maintain prototype delegation links via Object.create or ES6 classes.
3. Prevent losing execution context when passing methods as event or timer callbacks.
archetypes.governingInvariant: detachedMethod() executes with bound target receiver as this

cognitiveTraps.name: Detached Method Context Loss
cognitiveTraps.description: Passing object.method as a bare callback strips this binding, resulting in undefined or global this.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: const cb = obj.method; cb(); throws TypeError cannot read property of undefined.

realWorldDomains.description: Binding subscriber service instances to pub/sub event handlers safely.

archetypes.name: Object-to-Primitive Coercion & ValueOf Protocol
archetypes.coreConcept: Diagnosing and remediating defects in arithmetic and string coercion routines implementing Symbol.toPrimitive, valueOf, and toString protocols.
mentalModel: 1. Trace object-to-primitive conversion steps: preferredType hint ('number', 'string', 'default').
2. Validate that valueOf and toString return valid primitive values.
3. Ensure mathematical operations receive numeric primitives rather than string concatenations.
archetypes.governingInvariant: Symbol.toPrimitive(hint) returns primitive adhering to operand expectations

cognitiveTraps.name: String Concatenation in Numeric Arithmetic
cognitiveTraps.description: Returning string from valueOf causes '+' operator to perform string concatenation instead of addition.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Passing object with valueOf() => '10'; obj + 5 yields '105' instead of 15.

realWorldDomains.description: Fixing financial currency value objects to perform accurate arithmetic comparisons.

archetypes.name: Deep Object Cloner with Circular Reference Handling
archetypes.coreConcept: Recursively duplicating nested objects, arrays, and primitive fields while tracking visited object references via a Map/WeakMap to prevent infinite recursion on circular graphs.
mentalModel: 1. Base case: Return primitive values and functions as-is.
2. Check reference tracker: If object was already cloned, return existing clone reference.
3. Initialize new container (Array or Object) and register in reference map before recursively copying properties.
archetypes.governingInvariant: clone !== original; clone.circularRef === clone; deep mutations do not affect original

cognitiveTraps.name: Call Stack Overflow on Self-Referential Graph
cognitiveTraps.description: Naive JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) or un-memoized recursion crashes with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: const a = {}; a.self = a; deepClone(a); crashes without reference tracking.

realWorldDomains.description: Cloning state trees for time-travel debugging and snapshot isolation.

archetypes.name: Asynchronous Function Composition & Middleware Pipeline
archetypes.coreConcept: Constructing an onion-style asynchronous pipeline (similar to Koa/Express) that chains async middleware functions sequentially with next() downstream dispatch and upstream return propagation.
mentalModel: 1. Enforce that next() cannot be invoked multiple times in a single middleware frame.
2. Cascade execution downstream by awaiting the returned promise of next().
3. Catch downstream exceptions and allow upstream middleware to handle or rethrow them.
archetypes.governingInvariant: dispatch(i) executes middleware[i](context, next); multiple next() calls throw 'next() called multiple times'

cognitiveTraps.name: Multiple Next Invocation Defect
cognitiveTraps.description: Calling next() twice in one middleware branches execution and corrupts pipeline flow.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Middleware calls await next(); await next(); downstream executes duplicate operations.

realWorldDomains.description: Asynchronous HTTP request processing pipeline handling auth, rate-limiting, and logging.
